description: Cyclotron Production Evidence Registry (Cyclotron Production Evidence & Calibration Extension). A traceable store of external / physics production evidence that the Cyclotron Production Estimation Authority may consume as a MODELED_ESTIMATE basis where no manufacturer/site-calibrated production record exists. This registry NEVER holds manufacturer-calibrated or site-calibrated production output: those live in cyclotron_equipment_catalog.json (Build 3B). Literature / reaction-physics evidence here is classified MODELED_ESTIMATE only and never promoted. Raw evidence values are preserved verbatim alongside their normalized (MBq / MBq-per-uA) forms; the raw catalog is never mutated.

governance.no_cross_model_borrowing: A record whose catalog_model_id is null carries REACTION-LEVEL nuclear physics (a property of the reaction, not of any machine). It may be applied ONLY together with a specific machine's OWN published beam energy + beam current; it is never a borrowed machine capacity. A record naming a catalog_model_id applies ONLY to that model.
governance.no_cross_radionuclide_borrowing: Each record qualifies exactly one radionuclide via its own reaction/half-life; an F-18 record never qualifies C-11/N-13/O-15/Ga-68/Cu-64/Zr-89/I-123/I-124/Tc-99m.
governance.calibration_status_unchanged: Consuming a MODELED_ESTIMATE record NEVER changes a model's Build 3B production_calibration_status.
governance.generator_boundary: Generator daughters (e.g. Tc-99m) are OUT_OF_CYCLOTRON_SCOPE and never appear here.

evidence_records.normalization_method: GBq/uA -> MBq/uA (x1000). Saturation (t->inf, EOB) yield of the 18O(p,n)18F reaction; equals the coefficient K such that A_EOB(I,t) = (saturation_yield_mbq_per_ua) * I * (1 - exp(-lambda*t)).

source.title: Measurement of the 18F saturation yield from the 18O(p,n)18F reaction (thick liquid target)
source.author: Mirzaii et al.

limitations: REACTION-LEVEL physics (a property of the 18O(p,n)18F reaction), NOT a machine-specific EOB measurement.
Reported as ~80% of theoretical yield; applies to enriched [18O]water liquid targets above the reaction threshold.
When applied to a specific cyclotron model it is combined ONLY with that model's OWN published beam current/energy; it is never a borrowed machine capacity.
MODELED_ESTIMATE only: never manufacturer-calibrated or site-calibrated.
reference_irradiation_minutes=120 is the standard FDG production irradiation used as the default modeling condition; the estimator honors a caller-supplied irradiation time for the response curve.
